_comment: AD-9 model seeding: agent-slug -> default Claude model. A value is either a bare model id string or an object { "model": "<id>", "criterion": "<why this agent is on this tier>" }. The object form is the one the five-binding rule requires (doc/pack-infrastructure.md §7): a mapping without a stated criterion is a binding gap, because 'sonnet' on its own records a decision nobody can review. Consumed at member-creation time by AgentsTemplateService.DefaultModels() (GigaClaw.Core/Services/AgentsTemplateService.cs) and by GigaClaw.Catalog. Editing this file after a project already has members has no effect on those members — change the member's DefaultModel directly (PATCH /api/projects/{slug}/members/{memberId}) instead. Model ids must match GigaClaw.Core/Models/ClaudeModelCatalog.cs. Tier shorthand: haiku = mechanical/high-volume/low-ambiguity; sonnet = drafting/coding/analysis/research; opus = judgment/gates/auditing/watchdog. Per wshobson caveat, security and reviewer agents must not use sub-Opus tiers. The criterion states why *this* agent sits on *this* tier — not what the tier means.

code-janitor.criterion: Applies formatting and dead-code removal a linter has already located; the diff is mechanical and fully reviewable.

committer.criterion: Stages an already-final diff and writes its message; no decision it makes changes what ships.

documentalist.criterion: Transcribes decisions that were already made elsewhere; the source text constrains the output almost completely.

groomer.criterion: Normalizes ticket titles, labels and descriptions against a checklist stated in full in its SKILL.

trend-researcher.criterion: Collects and tabulates search results; ranking and interpretation are handed to writer agents downstream.

blog-researcher.criterion: Fetches and verifies many sources per run; volume dominates and every claim is checked against a fetched page rather than recalled.

blog-seo.criterion: Applies an enumerated on-page checklist to a finished draft; each check is stated, but needs the whole article in context.

blog-translator.criterion: Whole-article translation with format preservation; long-context fidelity matters more than open-ended reasoning.

blog-writer.criterion: Bulk long-form drafting against a brief that already fixes structure and evidence; a miss costs a revision, not a shipped defect.

competitive-analyst.criterion: Structured comparison of named competitors along stated dimensions; broad reading, bounded conclusions.

content-series-planner.criterion: Sequences an already-approved topic set; the planning space is bounded by that list.

content-writer.criterion: Bulk drafting from a brief, with a reviewer gate downstream that catches quality misses before publication.

data-analyst.criterion: Computes and explains metrics from supplied data; correctness is checkable against that same data.

design-researcher.criterion: Gathers and summarizes design precedent; the output is evidence for a designer, never itself a decision.

email-copywriter.criterion: Short-form drafting against a stated offer and audience; output length bounds the failure.

growth-writer.criterion: High-volume campaign drafting; every piece passes a reviewer before it reaches an audience.

lead-magnet-creator.criterion: Assembles an asset from an approved outline and existing research; the outline does the structural work.

local-image-artist.criterion: Writes prompts and drives the local image pipeline; the pipeline, not the model, determines the rendered result.

local-media-compositor.criterion: Assembles rendered clips against a storyboard that already fixes the cut.

local-motion-artist.criterion: Drives the motion pipeline from a storyboard; parameters are bounded and every render is reviewable.

producer.criterion: Routes and coordinates tickets against stated rules; dispatched constantly, and every routing decision is visible on the board.

programmer.criterion: Implements against an accepted ticket with the test suite as the oracle; a wrong answer fails the suite instead of shipping.

qa-tester.criterion: Runs the suite and reports what failed; the failing test is the evidence, so the judgement stays bounded by observable output.

ui-designer.criterion: Produces component markup and styles inside an existing design system that constrains the answer.

wellness-coach.criterion: Conversational guidance from stated routines; no gate and no shipped artifact depends on it.

approval-gatekeeper.criterion: Final human-substitute approval; the ticket ships on its word, with no downstream check to catch a wrong yes.

blog-reviewer.criterion: Emits the gating BLOG-REVIEW receipt that blog-seo refuses to run without; the verdict carries veto power over publication.

decision-engine.criterion: Chooses between options with no checklist to fall back on, and its choice redirects the whole board.

evaluator.criterion: Scores other agents' work and writes the scores later automations read; it is the measurement, so nothing cheaper can measure it.

local-media-director.criterion: Open-ended creative direction with no oracle downstream; the storyboard it emits constrains every later media agent.

local-media-reviewer.criterion: Gating verdict on rendered media — the only check standing between a bad render and publication.

system-watchdog.criterion: Adversarial reasoning over runtime anomalies nobody told it to look for; the failure mode is not noticing.

ui-auditor.criterion: Emits the gating UI-AUDIT verdict and counts its own review cycles; an accepted regression reaches users.
